features: 📶 Reliable Wi-Fi Connectivity for Everyday Use: Stay seamlessly connected with stable Wi-Fi support, allowing you to enjoy smooth web browsing, HD video streaming, online classes, and fast app downloads without interruptions, making it ideal for both work and entertainment

⚙️ Smooth Performance with 1.6GHz Quad-Core Processor (Android 10): Powered by an efficient 1.6GHz Quad-Core processor along with Android 10, this tablet delivers responsive performance, faster app loading, and smooth multitasking for everyday tasks like browsing, online learning, streaming, and light gaming

💾 3GB RAM with 16GB Storage (Expandable Up to 32GB): Designed for smooth multitasking, the 3GB RAM allows easy switching between apps, while 16GB internal storage lets you store essential files, apps, and media, with the flexibility to expand storage up to 32GB for added convenience

📸 Dual Camera Setup for Basic Photography & Video Calls: Equipped with a 2MP rear camera for capturing photos and videos, along with a front camera for video calling, making it suitable for online meetings, virtual classes, and everyday communication needs

🖥️ 7-Inch Display with Compact & Portable Design: Enjoy clear and vibrant visuals on a 7-inch screen, perfect for watching videos, reading, or attending online classes, all packed in a lightweight and easy-to-carry design for on-the-go convenience
description: Experience performance and value with the IKALL N12 Pro , a 7-inch tablet designed to meet your everyday digital needs. Featuring a vibrant IPS HD display and a powerful octa-core processor, it delivers smooth multitasking and crisp visuals for work, streaming, or browsing. Stay connected on the go with Wi-Fi support, and enjoy ample storage with 3GB RAM and 16GB internal memory (expandable). Capture every moment with dual cameras—an 0.3MP front and a 2MP rear for sharp photos. Backed by a robust 3000mAh battery and running Android 10, the N12 Pro offers a seamless, user-friendly experience that blends productivity with entertainment. Whether you're working, studying, or relaxing, this tablet is built to keep up with your lifestyle.
